title: Anonymize IP in Logs
body: Due to the new european privacy law it would be great to have the possibility, to remove or at least anonymize the IP in the Yii logs.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: you can configure `Target::$prefix` to customize logging of IP: https://www.yiiframework.com/doc/api/2.0/yii-log-target#$prefix-detail

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: @cebe how would I go about configuring this value? I can't seem to find anything in the docs. Cheers.
